Free JPEG XL converter

Convert JPG and PNG pictures, GIFs and videos to JPEG XL (JXL) online, free, as many as you like. Rapier makes the files on your device with the encoder inside it, so it works offline and nothing is uploaded. A JPEG converts losslessly and restores the exact original; a video or animation becomes an animated JPEG XL.

Questions

How do I convert JPG to JXL?

Choose or drop your JPEGs, then download each file or all of them as one zip. A JPEG converts losslessly: the original comes back byte for byte.

How do I convert PNG to JXL?

The same way. A PNG converts losslessly by default, transparency included. For photos you can choose High quality for a smaller file.

How do I convert a video to JPEG XL?

Choose or drop an MP4, WebM or MOV your browser plays. It becomes an animated JPEG XL at up to 30 frames a second, without sound. A long or large video is made smaller or cut to fit your device, and the row says so.

How do I convert a GIF to JPEG XL?

The same way. An animated GIF, APNG or animated WebP becomes an animated JPEG XL with every frame and its timing. Lossless keeps every pixel of every frame.

Does it work offline?

Yes. The JPEG XL encoder is inside Rapier. Keep Rapier as one HTML file and convert pictures with no connection. Videos and animations need JPEG XL complete, a small download asked for once; after that they convert offline too.

How many pictures can I convert?

As many as you like. Rapier works through them a few at a time, and you can cancel. Download each file or all of them as zip files. If a device runs out of memory, the finished files are kept.

Is my picture uploaded?

No. Pictures and videos are converted on your device and never leave it.

Is it free?

Yes. Rapier is free and open source, with no account, ads or tracking.

Which browsers open JPEG XL?

Chrome 155, Firefox 158 and Safari 17 and later open JPEG XL. Any browser can make the files here.

How it works

The JPEG XL encoder is part of Rapier, which is one offline HTML file. Your browser reads each picture, or plays each video frame by frame, and the encoder writes the JPEG XL file on your device. Nothing is uploaded. A JPEG is carried into JPEG XL without decoding it, then restored and checked against the original before you download.

Why JPEG XL

A JPEG converts to a smaller file and restores the exact original. Other pictures come out smaller at the same quality. JPEG XL also holds transparency, high dynamic range and animation.

Use rapier-jxl in your site or app

rapier-jxl is the JPEG XL encoder inside Rapier: pure JavaScript with optional WebAssembly, MIT licensed, no dependencies. It encodes lossless and lossy pictures and animations, carries a JPEG exactly, and keeps alpha and HDR. The still encoder is about 86 KB gzipped; the complete one, with animation and the rest of the format, about 153 KB. Run npm install rapier-jxl, then import {toJXL} from rapier-jxl/image: toJXL(file, {worker}) returns a JPEG XL Blob.
